No bridge

A £5.99 buyer has no next step

Someone who buys The Joy Tracker gets a great worksheet, then nothing invites her closer. The jump from a £19.97 bundle to £555 of coaching is a big one to make on her own.

Open calendar

Anyone can book a discovery call

With no application in front of your booking link, calls aren’t filtered for readiness or budget before they land in your diary.

Posting-led

Every lead depends on today’s post

1,309 posts in, new coaching enquiries still rely on what you publish this week. Nothing turns your 78.1k followers into booked calls while you’re out on the fells.

Most people who love your content leave with a £5.99 workbook or nothing at all, and you can’t see which of them are ready for coaching.

Sound familiar?

Joy keeps being the thing that comes later

  • “I’ll relax when this project is done.” Then the next one starts.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why joy keeps moving when you treat it as the reward

The “when I finally…” trap, and why reaching the goal so rarely brings the feeling with it.

The 10-minute Joy Audit

Map what fills you up and what drains you across work, relationships, rest and play, so you can see where your joy went.

The simple neuroscience of noticing

How where you put your attention shapes what you notice each day, and how small repeated choices change it.

Meet the parts running your day

The achiever, the people-pleaser, the inner critic: how to lead them instead of taking orders from them.

Your joy-first morning

One daily practice that puts joy at the start of your day, not at the bottom of your to-do list.

Meet Meg

Hi, I’m Meg Holloway

I’m a mindset coach, adventurer and the founder of The Joy Project, based in Keswick in the Lake District.

In 2018 I woke up and realised I couldn’t remember the last time I’d felt truly happy. I spent the next five years stepping out of my comfort zone to work out what I actually wanted, and coaching is where I found it.

Now I coach women 1:1 with The Joy Project Method, run retreats in the fells, and share mindset, neuroscience and self mastery with 78.1k women on Instagram.

Script 1 · “The moving finish line”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why hitting the goal so often doesn’t bring the feeling with it.”

Body

“Most of us were taught that joy is the reward. Work hard, tick the boxes, then feel good. But the finish line keeps moving. The next project, the next goal. What changes things is flipping it: joy as the foundation you build on, not the prize at the end.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a free 60-minute live class. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera outdoors in the Lakes, on-screen text “joy = foundation” with a lime highlight.

Script 2 · “2018”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“In 2018 I realised I couldn’t remember the last time I’d felt truly happy.”

Body

“On paper, life was fine. So I spent the next five years stepping out of my comfort zone to work out what I actually wanted. The biggest lesson? Joy isn’t something you earn later. It’s something you practise now, in small ways, every day.”

CTA

“I’ll share what I learned in my free live masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: Meg on a jetty or fell path, slow walk to camera, then sit-down talking head.

Script 3 · “The 10-minute Joy Audit”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Try this 10-minute audit and see where your joy actually went.”

Body

“Score each part of your life out of 10 for joy: work, relationships, rest, play. Most people find one area quietly draining the rest. Once you can see it, you can start to change it, one small choice at a time.”

CTA

“We’ll do the full Joy Audit together in my free live class. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: overhead of a notebook with the audit being filled in, Meg’s voiceover, end on talking head.
